translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Maenoan John Baptist
Noan oatowe Erotes iwe soamwoonin Galilee a rongorong wunuunun Jesus.
A aengaeniir rhooan engaang kkewe naiun pwe, “Ieei iiy John Baptist, nge a menaw sefaaen. Ina faaen minne eyor maemaewan pwe epwe feeori kkeman kkeei reen.”
Pwe mmwan nge Erotes a akkiuneo pwe repwe torofi John nge ra geoni iwe ra oatoranong noan kanepwus. Erotes a feeori minneei faaen itaen Herodias iwe pwiuniuwaen Philip we pwiin.
Pwe John Baptist a fasiun aepini ngaeni Erotes pwe, “Ese fin ngaeniug oamw wopwe pwiuniuwaeni Herodias.”
Erotes e mwerhaen pwe epwe niiy noa John, nge e mesagiiur Jews pwe iga re iseni John pwe erhai profeta.
Nge raaenin gupwunon wupwutiwen Erotes, nge niewe naiun Herodias epwaai me weni mmweer rhooawe. Nge Erotes igin kker,
a ppwon ngaeni niewe pwe, “Iya aekkepan, pwe ngaang ipwe ngaenneog ese tiwegin meeta wo tingoar.”
Miniwe inan a akkiuneow pwe epwe tingoareei Erotes pwe, “Igina rhag nge wopwe ngaenneaei rhimwen John Baptist noan eew saepiy!”
Iwe rhag nge e aenneew noa tipaen king we, nge pwonno igiwe a aekkepan weni mmweer waseona kkewe, a aepesa pwe mwerhaen we aaen rhooapwut we naiun epwe mmwen.
Iwe a akkiuneo pwe repwe noa gopiy noa iiuwaen John me noan kanepwus.
Iwe, ra pwigito miniwe rhimwen John noan eew saepiy nge ra ngaenneei aeterhooapwut we, iwe niewe a pwigi noa reen niewe inan.
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun John ra itto pwigi miniwe oanongan nge ra noa paeia noa. Iwe nge ra noa aengaeni Jesus.
Jesus e Oamwongoor Nimingeras Aeremas

Igiwe Jesus a rongorong miniwe kkepesaen John, a tapweei efoarh pwoot saengi igiwe nge a noa ngaeni eew pwiuneoi ne iiy noa rhag. Nge igiwe aeremas ra rongorong miniwe, ra noa saengi aepinoamwoor nge ra tapweei noa mwirin me weni faniuw.
Jesus a teeotiw me wooan pwoot we, nge a giuneei pwuwaen aeremas kkewe, nge a igin faayeeor iwe a aecchipwaar tae rhooawe re semwaai me neeiir.

Noan faefin we nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra itto reen nge ra aengaeni pwe, “E igin anniug noa igeei, nge a pwan pwoong. Aefengaar noa aeremas kaan nee aepinoamw pwe repwe noa sipegin chuwaai aeneer mwongo.”
Nge Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Inamwo me rese noa, aaemi oawpwe ngaenneer meeta repwe mwongo!”
Nge iir ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Minne eyor remaem nge niffai rhag fenoawa me riiurhai iig.”
Iwe, Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Iwe oaw pwigito reei.”

Iwe nge a aepesa ngaeniir rhooawe pwe repwe mooat tiw wooan fetin kkewe. Iwe a pwigi fenoawa kkewe niffai me iig kkewe riiurhai, a fattae naaeng nge a fang aan maeipinen aerhigerhig Iwe a giniiy fenoawa kkewe nge a ngaenneer rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun, nge iir ra inetiy ngaeniir aeremas kkewe.
Oanongeer nge ra maegin mwongo iwe ra faeyemwaai noa. Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra oawuta seig me ruwowu rhiug reen nuseg kkewe.
Iwe nepeer mwaaen kkewe re mwongo nge nimingeras, nge rese paaepae rhooapwut me wonigaet.
Jesus e Faaeraeg Noa Weei Saaet
Iwe rhag nge Jesus a aepekkaar rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe repwe teeotae wooan pwoot we, nge ra gommwonoa epeig meoneoiniun we, nge iiy a aefengaar noa aeremas kkewe.
Mwirin aan aefengaar noa aeremas kkewe, Jesus a ittae wooan rhug we nge iiy rhag, pwe epwe noa maeipin. Igiwe a pwongonoa, a iiy noa rhag igiwe.
Reen oateen nge pwoot we a taaw saengi faniuw, a nuponup pwoot we reen tettemoagon noa, nge igiwe repwan maeyi ngaeni aaeng.
Enoa nepetaen enuuw me wonowu konook nee oatosor Jesus a itto reer rhooan kkayeo kkewe, enoa faaeraegto weei saaet.
Igiwe ra giuneei aan faaeraegto weei saaet, ra igin mesag. Ra aekkepwas pwe, “Erhai aniu!”
Noan rhag oaton een nge Jesus a kkepas ngaeniir pwe, “Oaw aemenetaegaemi! Ngaang minneei, oawte mesag!”
Iwe Peter a aepesa pwe, “Soamwoon, aere een minna, aengaeniaei pwe ipwe faaeraeg wow reemw wooan saaet.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Itto!” Iwe Peter a teeotiw me wooan pwoot we nge a faaeraeg noa reen Jesus weei saaet.
Nge igiwe a weri maemaewaen aaeng we, a mesag nge a rhaepetae aan mwotupwutiw. Iwe, a aekkepwas pwe, “Aemenewaeyaei Soamwoon!”
Iwe rhag nge Jesus a aeiti noa paiun, a ammwarhiu Peter nge a aengaeni pwe, “Me gaen mwittiginen oamw niugiuniug! Meeta wotip mwaramwar reen?”
Iwe ra teeotae wooan pwoot we, iwe nge aaeng we a maseoseotiw.
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe reno wooan pwoot we ra aesirowu Jesus nge ra aepesa pwe, “Ennetaen pwe een Naiun Deus!”
Jesus a Aecchipwaar Rhooa Semwaai Noan Gennesaret
Iwe ra seraeg noa epeig meoneoiniun we nge ra noa itto noan me Gennesaret.
Aeremesaen pwiuneoi we re aeginna Jesus iwe ra aepesa noa wooan oanongaen faniuw pwe Jesus a no. Iwe aeremas ra pwigiir to oanongeer rhooa semwaai reen Jesus.
Ra tingoar ngaeni pwe aere uwen aar mwo man semwaai geotteopa soapwon mengaagiun. Iwe oanongeer iyo kkewe re geotteopa ra mamaaw noa.
